story: Alex stared at the glowing screen, his knuckles turning a stark, bone-white shade as he gripped the edge of his desk. The silence in the room felt heavy, pressing against his eardrums like deep water, amplifying the erratic thumping of his own heart. He deliberately crushed the empty coffee cup in his hand, the cardboard fibers tearing with a satisfying, sharp crunch that echoed too loudly in the stillness. His jaw muscles twitched involuntarily, a sharp spasm of tension that refused to release despite his conscious effort to breathe slowly and deeply. Every notification chime that followed seemed to scrape against his nerves, pulling tighter until he felt like a rubber band stretched to its absolute, breaking limit.

Alex stared at the blinking cursor on his screen, his jaw clenching so tightly that a sharp pain radiated up toward his temple. The coffee in his mug had long since gone cold, yet he gripped the ceramic handle with white-knuckled intensity, feeling the heat of his own palms seep into the material. He typed a sentence, deleted it immediately, and then slammed his fist onto the desk, causing the stack of papers to scatter across the floor. His breathing became shallow and rapid, each inhale feeling like a struggle against an invisible weight pressing down on his chest. He stood up abruptly, knocking his chair backward with a loud crash that echoed through the empty office.

Alex stared at the screen, his jaw clenching so tightly that a sharp pain radiated up into his temple. He slammed his fist onto the desk, sending a cascade of pens rolling to the floor with a clatter that seemed deafening in the silent office. His breathing became shallow and rapid, each inhale feeling like it scraped against the inside of his throat. The email draft remained untouched, the cursor blinking mockingly in the center of the white void. He stood up abruptly, knocking his chair back with a violent screech against the hardwood, and marched toward the exit without looking back.
